**Extract Boundary Faces:** Remove any faces of the polytope that lie on the boundary of the hypercube.
**Triangulate:** The remaining faces of the polytope comprise the isosurface in $n$ dimensions.
If these faces are not simplices, perform triangulation.
**Encode and Lookup:** Encode the cell vertex values relative to the iso-value using one bit per vertex (1 if value > iso-value, 0 otherwise) to form an index.
